title: Iberian orca known for ramming boats seen with suspected gunshot wounds

paragraphs.en: Spanish officials have launched an investigation after the matriarch of an orca pod known for jostling and ramming boats off the Iberian Peninsula was spotted with wounds suggesting she had been shot by a pellet gun.
paragraphs.zh: 西班牙官方已展开调查，此前，一个以在伊比利亚半岛附近海域推挤和撞击船只而闻名的虎鲸群的首领虎鲸被发现带有疑似遭气枪射击造成的伤口。

paragraphs.en: On Friday, Spain’s environment ministry said Toñi, the oldest living member of the pod, had been seen swimming in the Strait of Gibraltar with markings on her dorsal fin that were “consistent with shots from a pellet gun”.
paragraphs.zh: 上周五，西班牙环境部表示，该鲸群中现存最年长的成员托妮（Toñi）被发现游弋在直布罗陀海峡，其背鳍上有与“气枪射击痕迹相符”的标记。

paragraphs.en: Related: Humpbacks return to Rio: the whales are back from the brink of extinction – but will tourism help or hinder?
paragraphs.zh: 相关报道：座头鲸重返里约：鲸鱼已从灭绝边缘回归——但旅游业将提供帮助还是构成阻碍？

paragraphs.en: A source from the ministry told El País that some of the projectiles remained lodged in her fin, posing a risk of infection. The ministry was in touch with officials in Portugal, the source added, as the markings were detected after the orcas had travelled from the waters off the Portuguese city of Faro.
paragraphs.zh: 环境部一位消息人士告诉《国家报》，一些弹丸仍残留在她的鳍上，存在感染风险。该消息人士补充说，由于这些标记是在虎鲸从葡萄牙法鲁市附近海域游来之后被发现的，环境部已与葡萄牙官员取得联系。

paragraphs.en: The orcas of the Iberian Peninsula burst into headlines in 2020 after sailors shared stories of rudders that had been rammed and boats that had been spun 180 degrees or tipped sideways. Since then, a small group of orcas from the pod have been blamed for damaging scores of vessels and sinking at least four boats, leaving scientists scrambling to explain the baffling behaviour.
paragraphs.zh: 2020年，伊比利亚半岛的虎鲸登上头条，当时水手们纷纷分享船舵被撞击、船只被旋转180度或被掀翻倾斜的故事。自那以后，该鲸群中的一小群虎鲸被指损坏了数十艘船只，并至少击沉了四艘船，让科学家们争相解释这一令人费解的行为。

paragraphs.en: Scientists have long pushed back against the assertion that the orcas are attacking vessels, instead suggesting that the behaviour could be a form of play or a means of practising their hunting skills.
paragraphs.zh: 长期以来，科学家们一直反驳虎鲸是在攻击船只的说法，而是认为这种行为可能是一种玩耍形式，或是练习捕猎技巧的一种方式。

paragraphs.en: In the days since Toñi’s injuries came to light, the WeWhale and Iberian Orca Guardians (IOG) association have been closely tracking the animal for any sign of weakness. “We know Toñi. We were with her a few weeks ago and these wounds were not there,” the IOG co-founder Janek Andre said.
paragraphs.zh: 自托妮受伤一事曝光以来，WeWhale和伊比利亚虎鲸守护者（IOG）协会一直在密切追踪这只虎鲸，留意其虚弱的任何迹象。“我们认识托妮。几周前我们还和她在一起，当时没有这些伤口。”IOG联合创始人雅内克·安德烈说。

paragraphs.en: “Seeing Toñi, la abuela [the grandmother], like this is devastating,” he added. “If someone has deliberately fired a shotgun at her, this is not only an act of extreme cruelty against an individual animal. It is an attack on one of the last remaining members of a critically endangered population.”
paragraphs.zh: “看到托妮——‘老奶奶’——变成这样，真是令人心碎。”他补充道，“如果有人蓄意朝她开枪，这不仅是对一只个体动物极其残忍的行为，更是对一个极度濒危种群仅存成员之一的攻击。”
